rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese word for a waterproof coat or jacket worn in the rain.

example.english: Remember to bring a raincoat when it rains.
example.jyutping: lok6 jyu5 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 jyu5 lau1 aa3

rows.note: Use this common Cantonese noun when the intended meaning is a condom rather than rainwear.

example.english: A condom isn't a raincoat; you can't use it to keep off the rain.
example.traditional: 安全套唔係雨褸，唔可以攞嚟擋雨。
example.jyutping: on1 cyun4 tou3 m4 hai6 jyu5 lau1 m4 ho2 ji5 lo2 lai4 dong2 jyu5
